morning.source: read off the watch; superseded by the weekly export

dailyLog.meals: Tea, 200 ml with 30 ml milk. 3 slices Inked Bread. 240 ml Pressed orange+beet juice. 1 tin sardines in olive oil, 85 g drained. All four read from labels or measured. Lunch: 2 cups rice, dhal, and 2.5 scrambled eggs with onion and Thai chilli. Afternoon: another tea with milk, no sugar, plus a chickpea snack. Dinner: pasta.
dailyLog.symptoms: Slight cramp in both calves. Bilateral, at rest, the day after wearing a 20 lb vest for about an hour.
dailyLog.carbsEstimateMethod: Every item from a label or his own measurement: bread 3 g net (33 g total, 30 g fibre), juice 25 g, tea 1.5 g, sardines 0 g, SuperBeets 4 g. Nothing estimated.
dailyLog.supplements: SuperBeets 1 tsp, D3/K2 5,000 IU + 100 mcg MK-7, Omega-3 1,055 mg (EPA 690 / DHA 310). All three labels photographed and read.
dailyLog.water: 2 Liquid IV pouches, taken roughly 4 hours apart
